# pve_replication (Data Source)

Reads a single storage replication job from `GET /cluster/replication/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_replication" "vm100" {
  id = "100-0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Replication Job ID to look up, in the `<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>` form (e.g. `100-0`).

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form description, or null when the job has none.
- `digest` (String) Configuration digest of the job, or null when PVE reports none.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the job is disabled/deactivated.
- `guest` (Number) Guest ID the job replicates, decoded by PVE from the job ID.
- `jobnum` (Number) Job number component of the replication job ID.
- `rate` (Number) Rate limit in MB/s, or null when the job is unlimited.
- `schedule` (String) Replication schedule as a `systemd` calendar event subset, or null when the job carries none.
- `target` (String) Target node that receives the replicated volumes.
- `type` (String) Section type; always `local`.
